content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "Roasted potatoes", "grams": 110, "kcal": 170}, {"name": "Mixed green salad", "grams": 70, "kcal": 25}, {"name": "Couscous salad with vegetables", "grams": 90, "kcal": 130}, {"name": "Feta cheese crumbles", "grams": 25, "kcal": 65}, {"name": "Quinoa or grain with creamy chicken salad", "grams": 130, "kcal": 240}, {"name": "Cherry tomatoes", "grams": 30, "kcal": 6}, {"name": "Red onion slices", "grams": 12, "kcal": 5}, {"name": "Red bell pepper pieces", "grams": 20, "kcal": 6}, {"name": "Frisée lettuce", "grams": 8, "kcal": 2}]}
